diaspora_bullets: Harmeet Desai and Yashaswini Ghorpade beat South Korea's Park Ganghyeon and Lee Daeun
They lost the semi-final to Japan's Sora Matsushima and Miwa Harimoto
news_summary: Harmeet Desai and Yashaswini Ghorpade won bronze in mixed doubles at the Asian Table Tennis Championships in Tashkent, India's first medal in the event since 1954.
payoff: India's first mixed doubles medal in 72 years — and only its third ever at the championships.
